perm.consent.title: Scan this network?
perm.consent.body: Ajar looks at which devices are connected and which doors they have open. It doesn't try passwords and changes nothing.
perm.consent.point2: Results stay on this computer only
perm.consent.owner: I confirm this network is mine or I'm allowed to scan it.
perm.admin.title: Ajar needs administrator rights
perm.admin.body: Only for the scan step. Your system may ask for the computer's password.
perm.admin.point1: The rights are used only to scan your network
perm.admin.point2: The rest of the app runs without special rights
perm.admin.note: If a window appears, it comes from your system, not from Ajar.
perm.network.title: Allow local network access
perm.network.body: Ajar needs to see the devices on your Wi-Fi to check them.
perm.network.point1: Only the network you're connected to
perm.network.point3: You can take it back in your system settings
perm.network.note: If a window appears, it comes from your system, not from Ajar.
perm.notify.title: Want me to tell you when something new shows up?
perm.notify.body: I'll send a notification if a new device appears or a new door opens since the last scan.
perm.notify.point2: Turn them off any time in your browser settings
perm.ai.title: Turn on the assistant?
perm.ai.body: To answer you, the assistant sends this scan's results to an AI service.
perm.ai.point1: Only the problems found, with MACs hidden
perm.ai.point2: No passwords and no other personal data
perm.ai.point3: Without the assistant, the built-in explanations stay
perm.ai.note: You can change your mind later on the Ask page.
